about: Works layout, metres: x across the lane (0 on its centre line, No. 1 at minus x, No. 2 at plus x); y away from the lane (0 at the works wall's face on the lane side); z up from the ground. Place the root at the wall's face on the lane's centre line (for a lane built with --length L, at y = L). In three.js a point (x, y, z) is (x, z, -y).

models.description: No. 2, the flat-out factory (always on the right): pale buff-grey brick, two square chimneys of a paler buff (sooted only just under the cap, their faces toward the lane and their sides lit warm by the yard), a water tank on a steel trestle, long pitched shed roofs with glazed lanterns, a two-storey mill front with upper windows, cart doors open on a lit works, a taking-in door with a hoist beam. Saved with every window lit.

mill.roof: three pitched spans, gables to the lane, ridges 8.85 m, 9.84 m, 9.84 m, lanterns on each ridge

models.lettering: none (no signs, no lettering, no figures)
